title: American Height Rose While the World Passed It
hook: American men grew taller, yet their global height lead disappeared.
closing: National height can improve while faster gains elsewhere still erase a country's advantage.
question: Are you taller than your grandparents?

segments.say: American men's average height reached 177 centimeters. The gain was real, but it did not preserve their global lead.
South Korean women gained 20.2 centimeters. Much faster growth elsewhere changed what counted as tall.
By 2014, 36 countries had taller average men than the US. A gain at home still became a ranking collapse.
